integrity: The displayed beta-moment proof and sharp-step maximization support the unrestricted theorem. Exact rational moment checks and finite numerical stress tests are supplementary evidence, not an infinite proof or independent verification.
scientific_limitations: The sharp theorem is for symmetric Jacobi weights, degree-two real orthogonal projection, and unweighted BV variation on an open interval. No claims for other degrees or asymmetric weights; exhaustive historical priority and independent audit remain unavailable.
title: Sharp bounded-variation norm and off-centre rigidity of quadratic Jacobi projection
